start.title: Crowds Climb the Hill
start.text:
Word spreads through the valley.
The teacher sits upon the hill.

choices.feedback: Matthew 5:1 — Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down, and his disciples came to him.

hurry_consequence.title: Pause
hurry_consequence.text:
Some words are worth stopping for.
Climb.

mock_consequence.title: Soften
mock_consequence.text:
Pride deafens the heart.
Listen first.

beatitudes.title: Blessed Are
beatitudes.text:
"Blessed are the poor in spirit.
Theirs is the kingdom of heaven."

choices.feedback: Matthew 5:3 — Jesus said, "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven."

boast_consequence.title: Lay It Down
boast_consequence.text:
He blesses the meek, not the proud.
Receive his word.

mercy.title: Blessed Are the Merciful
mercy.text:
"Show mercy, and you will receive it.
Pure hearts will see God."

choices.feedback: Matthew 5:7 — Jesus taught, "Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy."

grudge_consequence.title: Release
grudge_consequence.text:
Mercy untangles the heart.
Let it go.

judge_consequence.title: Look Inward
judge_consequence.text:
Remove the beam from your eye.
Then you will see.

salt_light.title: Salt and Light
salt_light.text:
"You are the light of the world.
Let your light shine before others."

choices.feedback: A lamp belongs on a stand.
Matthew 5:16 — Jesus said, "Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven."

hide_consequence.title: Shine
hide_consequence.text:
Salt forgotten loses its taste.
Give what you carry.

enemies.title: Love Your Enemies
enemies.text:
"Love your enemies.
Pray for those who hurt you."

choices.feedback: Matthew 5:44 — Jesus commanded, "Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you."

curse_consequence.title: Bless Instead
curse_consequence.text:
Cursing keeps the wound open.
Pray for them.

repay_consequence.title: Break the Cycle
repay_consequence.text:
Evil cannot drive out evil.
Only love can.

worry.title: Do Not Worry
worry.text:
"Look at the birds, the lilies.
Your Father knows your need."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:26 — Jesus pointed out that God feeds the birds of the air, and Matthew 6:28-30 — clothes the lilies of the field, indicating God's care for his people.

worry_consequence.title: Today
worry_consequence.text:
Tomorrow will care for itself.
Trust him now.

foundation.title: Build on the Rock
foundation.text:
"Hear my words and live them.
Build your house upon the rock."

choices.text: Build your life on his word
choices.feedback: Matthew 7:24 — Jesus stated that everyone who hears his words and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

sand_consequence.title: Choose Rock
sand_consequence.text:
Sand gives way in the storm.
Choose the firm ground.

choices.text: Build your life on his word

ending.title: The Crowd Was Amazed
ending.text:
You walk down the mountain changed.
His words have become your house.
